chapters.title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
chapters.synopsis: Solomon, established in the kingdom, worships at the brasen altar in Gibeon, and God appears by night offering him whatever he asks. Solomon asks for wisdom and knowledge to judge so great a people. God grants wisdom and adds riches and honor, and Solomon gathers chariots, horsemen, and wealth in Jerusalem.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Solomon worships at the brasen altar in Gibeon

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Solomon asks wisdom; God adds riches and honor

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Chariots, horsemen, and silver as stones

chapters.title: Preparing to Build the House
chapters.synopsis: Solomon determines to build a house for the name of the Lord and a house for his kingdom, and numbers a vast workforce of bearers and hewers. He writes to Huram king of Tyre for cedar from Lebanon and a craftsman skilled in gold, purple, and engraving. Huram answers gladly and sends Huram his master workman.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Solomon's letter to Huram; laborers numbered

chapters.title: Building Begins on Moriah
chapters.synopsis: Solomon begins to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared to David at the threshingfloor of Ornan. The chronicler records the measurements, the gold-overlaid holy places, the carved cherubim, and the veil. Two great pillars, Jachin and Boaz, are set before the temple.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The temple built on Moriah; the pillars raised

chapters.title: Furnishings of the Temple
chapters.synopsis: Solomon makes the altar of brass, the great molten sea standing on twelve oxen, ten lavers, ten golden candlesticks, and ten tables. Huram finishes the pots, shovels, and basins of bright brass cast in the plain of Jordan. The vessels of gold for the house of God are completed in great abundance.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The molten sea, lavers, and golden vessels

chapters.title: The Ark Enters the Temple
chapters.synopsis: The work finished, Solomon assembles the elders of Israel, and the Levites bring the ark of the covenant up from the city of David into the holy of holies. Nothing is in the ark save the two tables Moses put there at Horeb. As singers and trumpeters praise the Lord as one, a cloud of glory fills the house so the priests cannot stand to minister.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The ark brought up; glory fills the house

chapters.title: Solomon's Prayer of Dedication
chapters.synopsis: Solomon blesses the congregation, recounting how the Lord chose Jerusalem and fulfilled his promise to David. Kneeling on a brasen scaffold with hands spread toward heaven, he dedicates the temple, pleading that God will hear from heaven when his people pray toward this place — in sin, drought, famine, or captivity — and forgive.

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: Solomon blesses the assembled congregation

segments.speaker: solomon
segments.note: The dedication prayer: hear thou from heaven

chapters.title: Fire From Heaven Answers
chapters.synopsis: Fire comes down from heaven and consumes the offerings, and the glory of the Lord fills the house as all Israel worships. Solomon keeps the feast seven days and sends the people away glad of heart. The Lord appears to Solomon by night: if my people humble themselves, pray, and turn from their wicked ways, I will hear and heal their land — but apostasy will make this house an astonishment.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Fire falls; the feast of dedication kept

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: If my people humble themselves and pray

chapters.title: Solomon's Cities and Service
chapters.synopsis: In twenty years Solomon builds store cities, fortifies Beth-horon, and settles conquered peoples under tribute. He brings Pharaoh's daughter to her own house, keeps the appointed feasts and offerings, and sets the courses of priests and Levites as David ordered. His ships bring gold from Ophir.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Building projects, ordered worship, gold from Ophir

chapters.title: The Queen of Sheba Marvels
chapters.synopsis: The queen of Sheba comes to prove Solomon with hard questions and finds the half of his wisdom was not told her; there is no more spirit in her. The chronicler catalogs Solomon's gold, ivory throne, and fleet, for he passes all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom. After reigning forty years, Solomon sleeps with his fathers, and Rehoboam reigns.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The queen of Sheba proves Solomon with questions

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Solomon's incomparable wealth, reign, and death

chapters.title: The Kingdom Is Divided
chapters.synopsis: All Israel gathers at Shechem to make Rehoboam king, asking him to lighten Solomon's heavy yoke. Rejecting the old men's counsel for that of his young companions, Rehoboam answers roughly: my father chastised you with whips, but I with scorpions. Ten tribes revolt to Jeroboam, and Israel rebels against the house of David to this day.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Rehoboam's harsh answer; ten tribes revolt

chapters.title: Judah Strengthened, Priests Gather
chapters.synopsis: Rehoboam musters an army to reclaim Israel, but the prophet Shemaiah forbids war against their brethren, for this thing is from God. Rehoboam fortifies cities of defence in Judah. The priests and Levites, cast off by Jeroboam's golden calves, leave their suburbs and come to Jerusalem, strengthening the kingdom for three years.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Shemaiah forbids war against Israel

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Fenced cities; faithful Levites gather to Judah

chapters.title: Shishak Humbles Rehoboam
chapters.synopsis: When Rehoboam is established, he forsakes the law of the Lord, and Shishak king of Egypt comes up against Jerusalem with a vast host. At Shemaiah's word the princes humble themselves, so the Lord grants some deliverance, though Shishak carries away the treasures and Solomon's golden shields. Rehoboam does evil because he prepared not his heart to seek the Lord.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Shishak invades; princes humble themselves

chapters.title: Abijah Trusts the Covenant
chapters.synopsis: War arises between Abijah of Judah and Jeroboam of Israel. From Mount Zemaraim Abijah declares that the Lord gave the kingdom to David by a covenant of salt, and that Judah keeps the true priesthood and worship while Israel serves golden calves. Though ambushed and outnumbered two to one, Judah cries to the Lord and prevails, because they rely upon the God of their fathers.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: War between Abijah and Jeroboam

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Abijah's speech: God himself is with us

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Judah cries to God and prevails

chapters.title: Asa's Reform and Deliverance
chapters.synopsis: Asa does what is good and right, taking away strange altars and high places and commanding Judah to seek the Lord; the land has rest ten years. When Zerah the Ethiopian comes with a host of a thousand thousand, Asa cries that it is nothing with the Lord to help, whether with many or with them that have no power. The Lord smites the Ethiopians before Judah.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Asa's reforms; the land at rest

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Asa's cry; Zerah's million-man host routed

chapters.title: A Covenant to Seek the Lord
chapters.synopsis: The Spirit comes on Azariah, who tells Asa the Lord is with you while ye be with him; if ye seek him, he will be found. Emboldened, Asa purges the idols, renews the altar, and gathers Judah with strangers from Israel who see that God is with him. They covenant with shouting and trumpets to seek the Lord with all their heart, and he gives them rest.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Azariah's prophecy: the Lord is with you

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Judah covenants with an oath to seek God

chapters.title: Asa Leans on Syria
chapters.synopsis: When Baasha of Israel builds Ramah against him, Asa buys help from Ben-hadad of Syria with temple treasure instead of relying on the Lord. The seer Hanani rebukes him — the eyes of the Lord run to and fro to shew himself strong for the perfect heart — and Asa angrily imprisons him. Diseased in his feet, Asa seeks physicians and not the Lord, and dies.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The Syrian treaty; Hanani rebukes Asa

chapters.title: Jehoshaphat Teaches the Law
chapters.synopsis: Jehoshaphat strengthens himself against Israel, seeks the God of his father, and walks in his commandments; his heart is lifted up in the ways of the Lord. In his third year he sends princes, Levites, and priests with the book of the law to teach throughout the cities of Judah. The fear of the Lord falls on surrounding kingdoms, and Judah grows mighty.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Teachers sent through Judah with the law

chapters.title: Micaiah Prophesies Ahab's Fall
chapters.synopsis: Jehoshaphat joins affinity with Ahab, who urges him to war at Ramoth-gilead while four hundred prophets promise victory. Micaiah alone tells the truth: Israel scattered as sheep without a shepherd, and a lying spirit in the prophets' mouths. Ahab disguises himself in battle, but a bow drawn at a venture strikes him between the joints of his harness, and he dies at sunset.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Ahab's alliance; four hundred prophets flatter

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Micaiah's vision: Israel scattered, a lying spirit

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Ahab disguised, slain by a chance arrow

chapters.title: Judges Set Throughout Judah
chapters.synopsis: The seer Jehu meets Jehoshaphat returning from Ramoth-gilead: shouldest thou help the ungodly? yet good things are found in thee. Jehoshaphat goes out among the people to bring them back to the Lord and appoints judges city by city. He charges them to judge for the Lord and not for man, for there is no iniquity with the Lord, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Jehu's rebuke; judges charged to fear God

chapters.title: The Battle Is Not Yours
chapters.synopsis: A great multitude of Moab, Ammon, and Mount Seir comes against Jehoshaphat, who proclaims a fast and prays before all Judah: we have no might, neither know we what to do, but our eyes are upon thee. The Spirit tells Jahaziel the battle is not yours, but God's. Singers sent before the army praise the beauty of holiness, the invaders destroy one another, and Judah spends three days gathering spoil.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Judah fasts; Jehoshaphat's prayer of dependence

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Jahaziel: the battle is God's, not yours

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Singers lead; the enemies destroy each other

chapters.title: Jehoram Walks in Ahab's Ways
chapters.synopsis: Jehoram slays all his brothers with the sword and, married to Ahab's daughter, leads Judah into idolatry; yet the Lord will not destroy the house of David because of his covenant. A writing from Elijah warns of a great plague on his people and a fearful disease in his bowels. Edom revolts, the Philistines and Arabians spoil his house, and Jehoram dies unlamented.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Jehoram's murders; Elijah's letter of doom

chapters.title: Athaliah Seizes the Throne
chapters.synopsis: Ahaziah reigns one year, counselled to his destruction by the house of Ahab, and is slain in Jehu's purge. His mother Athaliah then destroys all the seed royal of Judah. But Jehoshabeath hides the infant Joash in the house of God for six years while Athaliah reigns over the land.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Ahaziah slain; Joash hidden from Athaliah

chapters.title: Joash Crowned, Athaliah Slain
chapters.synopsis: In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest gathers the Levites and captains, and they crown the boy Joash in the temple, crying God save the king. Athaliah rends her clothes and cries treason, and is put to death outside the house of the Lord. Jehoiada makes a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people, and the altars of Baal are broken down.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The hidden heir crowned; Baal's house broken

chapters.title: Joash Repairs, Then Forsakes
chapters.synopsis: Joash does right all the days of Jehoiada, gathering money in a chest to repair the house of the Lord. After Jehoiada dies, the princes turn the king to idols; Jehoiada's son Zechariah testifies against them and is stoned at the king's command in the temple court. A small Syrian band executes judgment on Judah, and Joash is slain on his bed by his own servants.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The chest at the gate; the house repaired

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Zechariah stoned; Joash slain by servants

chapters.title: Amaziah's Divided Heart
chapters.synopsis: Amaziah does right, but not with a perfect heart. At a prophet's word he sends home hired soldiers of Israel, trusting that God is able to give much more than a hundred talents, and defeats Edom — then brings home Edom's gods and worships them. Warned but unheeding, he provokes Joash of Israel, who breaks down Jerusalem's wall; conspirators later slay Amaziah at Lachish.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Hired hosts sent home; Edom defeated

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Edom's gods adopted; Israel humbles Amaziah

chapters.title: Uzziah's Pride Brings Leprosy
chapters.synopsis: Uzziah reigns fifty-two years, and as long as he seeks the Lord, God makes him prosper with armies, towers, engines of war, and vineyards, for he loves husbandry. But when he is strong his heart is lifted up: he enters the temple to burn incense, a right belonging only to the priests. Leprosy rises in his forehead, and he dwells in a several house, cut off from the house of the Lord.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Uzziah prospers marvellously while seeking God

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Presumptuous incense; leprosy until death

chapters.title: Jotham Prepares His Ways
chapters.synopsis: Jotham does right in the sight of the Lord, though he enters not into the temple as his father presumed to, and the people still do corruptly. He builds the high gate of the house of the Lord, fortifies cities, and subdues the Ammonites. Jotham becomes mighty because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Jotham mighty because his ways were prepared

chapters.title: Ahaz Deepens Judah's Apostasy
chapters.synopsis: Ahaz makes molten images for Baalim and burns his children in the fire, so the Lord delivers Judah to Syria and to Israel, which slays a hundred twenty thousand in one day. The prophet Oded persuades Israel to clothe, feed, and return their Judahite captives. In distress Ahaz trespasses yet more, sacrificing to the gods of Damascus and shutting up the house of the Lord.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Judah smitten; Oded frees the captives

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Ahaz shuts the temple, serves Damascus's gods

chapters.title: Hezekiah Opens the Doors
chapters.synopsis: In the first month of his first year, Hezekiah opens and repairs the doors of the house of the Lord and charges the Levites to sanctify it, for our fathers have trespassed. The priests carry the uncleanness out to the brook Kidron in sixteen days. Sin offerings are made for all Israel, and worship is restored with the words of David — the Levites sing praise with gladness while the burnt offering ascends.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Hezekiah's charge; the house cleansed

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Sin offerings; the song of the Lord begins

chapters.title: A Passover for All Israel
chapters.synopsis: Hezekiah sends posts from Beer-sheba to Dan, inviting even the remnant of Ephraim and Manasseh to return to the Lord and keep the passover at Jerusalem. Some laugh the messengers to scorn, but many humble themselves and come. Hezekiah prays for those unprepared — the good Lord pardon every one that prepareth his heart — and the feast is kept fourteen days with joy not seen since Solomon.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Letters to all Israel: turn again

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The great passover; Hezekiah prays for the unclean

chapters.title: Order and Offerings Restored
chapters.synopsis: The worshippers go out and break the images and cut down the groves throughout Judah and beyond. Hezekiah appoints the courses of priests and Levites and commands the people to give their portion, and tithes lie in heaps for four months. In every work he begins in the service of God's house, he does it with all his heart, and prospers.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Idols broken; tithes heaped; wholehearted service

chapters.title: Sennacherib Defied and Destroyed
chapters.synopsis: Sennacherib of Assyria invades Judah, and Hezekiah stops the fountains, strengthens the wall, and rallies the people: there be more with us than with him — with us is the Lord our God to fight our battles. Assyrian messengers rail against God as if he were like the idols of the nations. Hezekiah and Isaiah pray, and the Lord sends an angel who cuts off the host; Sennacherib returns shamefaced and is slain by his own sons.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: There be more with us than with him

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Assyria's railing; an angel destroys the host

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Hezekiah's sickness, pride, riches, and death

chapters.title: Manasseh Humbled and Restored
chapters.synopsis: Manasseh rebuilds the high places, sets a carved idol in God's house, and seduces Judah to do worse than the heathen. The Assyrians take him with hooks to Babylon, where in affliction he humbles himself greatly and prays; God is intreated and brings him back to Jerusalem, and Manasseh knows that the Lord he is God. He removes the idols, but his son Amon trespasses more and more and is slain by his servants.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Manasseh's sins, captivity, prayer, and return

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Amon's brief wicked reign

chapters.title: Josiah and the Book Found
chapters.synopsis: While yet young, Josiah begins to seek the God of David and purges Judah and even Israel of altars, groves, and images. During temple repairs Hilkiah finds the book of the law, and hearing it read, Josiah rends his clothes. The prophetess Huldah declares the written curses will come, but not in Josiah's days because his heart was tender; king and people covenant to keep the words of the book.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Young Josiah purges the land of idols

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The law found; Huldah; the covenant renewed

chapters.title: Josiah's Passover and Death
chapters.synopsis: Josiah keeps a passover to the Lord such as has not been kept since the days of Samuel the prophet, with the ark settled, the courses set, and thousands of offerings given by king and princes. Afterward he needlessly goes out against Pharaoh Necho at Megiddo, disguising himself, and archers wound him mortally. All Judah mourns, and Jeremiah laments for Josiah.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The greatest passover since Samuel's days

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Josiah slain at Megiddo; Jeremiah laments

chapters.title: The Fall and the Decree
chapters.synopsis: Judah's last kings — Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim, Jehoiachin, and Zedekiah — do evil, and Zedekiah stiffens his neck against Nebuchadnezzar and against Jeremiah speaking from the mouth of the Lord. The people mock the messengers God sends in compassion until there is no remedy: the Chaldees burn the house of God and carry Judah to Babylon for seventy years, until the land enjoys her sabbaths. Then Cyrus of Persia proclaims that the Lord has charged him to build him a house at Jerusalem: who is among you of all his people? let him go up.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim, Jehoiachin carried away

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Zedekiah rebels; Jerusalem burned; seventy years

segments.speaker: cyrus
segments.note: Cyrus's decree: go up and build
